description: Score a counterparty wallet for Environmental, Social, and Governance risk before a settlement. Required for EU SFDR Principal Adverse Impact reporting and CSRD financed emissions disclosure. Also use for internal counterparty sustainability assessment. Score is recalibrated hourly from institutional data sources with adaptive weights. Returns E/S/G sub-scores (0–100 each), composite weighted score, and the settlement fee adjustment this score produces. Omit address for the protocol default score.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...) to score. Omit for protocol default score.

name: esg.score
